title: PR drafting validates its handoff and renders the exact five-section response

provenance.originSummary: Synthetic benchmark for the PR drafting schema gate and presentation contract.
provenance.whyItMattered: The workflow must not render incomplete internal decisions or leak orchestration commentary around the copy-ready body.
provenance.genericCondition: One sanitized run supplies a complete schema-version 1.3 payload with a frozen execution boundary, stable repository evidence, and separate existing pull request evidence; invalid runs violate required fields, changelog state invariants, or PR/base conditions.

description: A valid payload renders exactly five ordered sections and the verification footer; an invalid payload produces only the exact schema hard stop.

scope.notes: The valid run models one existing Resource enhancement; the invalid run uses the same evidence but an incomplete internal handoff.

mustCatch.description: A payload missing a required schema property hard-stops before any normal section is rendered.
A valid schema-version 1.1 payload carries pull request discovery, trust, relation, references, and structured conflicts separately from comparison-base metadata.
The schema rejects category and keyword mismatches, recommended decisions without entries, non-recommended or breaking decisions with entries, and non-contract fallback text.
Active branch identity requires a PR base commit, while an existing-PR comparison base requires a pull request number and not-applicable refresh status.
A valid schema-version 1.3 payload requires lowercase initial and final SHA-256 fingerprints, stable=true, and a restart count of zero or one.

A valid schema-version 1.3 payload records one environment, canonical worktree, selection method, Git and Go executables, repository identity, branch, full HEAD, known source HEAD, dirty-state summary, candidate count, and bounded search roots.
A valid payload renders the five exact level-two headings in contract order.
The complete pull request body appears in one Markdown code block and excludes prompt-only evidence and issue-search sections.
The exact preflight and skill lines are the final response content with nothing after them.

mustNotFlag.description: A schema-invalid handoff must not emit a title, partial body, evidence notes, or footer.
The normal response must not add alternate titles, orchestration notes, or extra top-level headings.
A payload whose changelog category, keyword, status, entry count, or fallback text violates the contract must not pass schema validation.
A payload without the frozen worktree and execution-environment boundary must not pass schema validation or render a draft.

mustIncludeMarkers: Cannot run draft-pr-description: pr-description produced a schema-invalid draft payload. Refresh the workflow files and re-run this prompt.

notes: The paired Markdown example captures the valid output shape; the valid handoff uses schema version 1.3 and the exact hard-stop marker covers invalid runs.
